title: 第 13 章 难道你敢打女人
novel_title: 我被师姐凌辱，你说我罪恶滔天？
content_zh:
当她们刚刚走出陈默的院子以后，那几个师妹就围到了姜初然身边。

    “初然师姐你干嘛要跟那个陈默道歉啊？”一个师妹说道。

    “就是，他又不是什么了不起的人物你犯得着对他那么客气吗？”

    “你看他那副德性打了陆云师兄就以为自己天下无敌了，初然师姐我劝你离他远点。”

    “大长老已经知道这件事了听说非常震怒，很快就会找他算账的。”

    “这个时候你要是跟他走太近小心被大长老误会，到时候连累到你。”

    几个师妹纷纷的说着，一个个都在劝姜初然离陈默远一点。

    但姜初然倒是没有说话只是低着头往前走。

    于是她在心里想着。

    既然已经知道陈默现在手里有一门上品法术。

    要是能借来修炼一下，那她的实力肯定能提升不少。

    而且以前陈默对她那么好，送她灵石丹药以及送她各种修炼资源。

    只要她开口陈默从来没有拒绝过，如果自己好好跟他说一下他应该会尽力满足自己。

    想到这里她停下了脚步。

    “好了你们别说了。”

    几个师妹都看着她。

    “初然师姐怎么了？”

    “我想回去找陈默，借他的上品法术修炼一下。”

    几个师妹听到这话都愣住了。

    “初然师姐你没开玩笑吧？你找他借上品法术他肯借给你吗？”

    “就是啊，他现在连陆云师兄都敢打你觉得他还会像以前那样对你吗？”

    几个师妹对视了一眼都没有说话。

    这会儿她们在心里想着初然师姐也太天真了吧，陈默现在跟以前可不一样了。

    以前他是废物谁都看不起当然要对初然师姐百般讨好，现在他连陆云都打败了还能看得上初然师姐？

    可她们也不好当面泼冷水只好跟着她往回走。

    而陈默正准备回屋的时候，院门外又传来了脚步声。

    只见姜初然的身后还跟着刚刚那几个师妹，因此他的眉头微微皱了一下。

    “还有事？”

    当姜初然走进院子里站在他面前，在犹豫了一下以后开口道。

    “陈默我想跟你商量一件事。”

    “什么事？”

    “你那个上品法术能不能借我修炼一下？”

    说完之后她看着陈默眼神里还带着几分期待。

    “就借几天，等我修炼完了马上还给你。”

    然而陈默看着她没有说话。

    随后在心里想着。

    借上品法术？这个女人倒是挺会打如意算盘的。

    原主的记忆中这个女人可没少从原主那里拿东西。

    灵石丹药法术只要是原主有的她都要，原主为了讨她欢心把自己的修炼资源都给了她，结果自己的修为反而荒废了。

    而她呢？

    拿了东西之后就对他爱搭不理的。

    偶尔给个笑脸说几句好话原主就又屁颠屁颠的继续送。

    这特么不是纯绿茶吗？
content_en:
When they just walked out of Chen Mo's courtyard, the junior sisters gathered around Jiang Churan.

    "Sister Churan, why do you have to apologize to that Chen Mo?" said a junior sister.

    "That's right, he's not a great person. Can you be so polite to him?"

    "Look at his moral character and think that he is invincible when he beats Senior Brother Lu Yun. Senior Sister Churan, I advise you to stay away from him."

    "The Great Elder already knows about this and is very angry. He will settle the score with him soon."

    "If you get too close to him at this time, you may be misunderstood by the great elder, and you will be implicated later."

    Several junior sisters were talking one after another, each of them trying to persuade Jiang Churan to stay away from Chen Mo.

    But Jiang Churan didn't say anything and just walked forward with his head lowered.

    So she thought to herself.

    Now that we know that Chen Mo now has a high-grade spell in his hand.

    If she could borrow it to practice, her strength would definitely improve a lot.

    Moreover, Chen Mo was so kind to her in the past, giving her spiritual stones, pills, and various cultivation resources.

    As long as she opened her mouth, Chen Mo would never refuse her. If she told him properly, he would try his best to satisfy her.

    Thinking of this, she stopped.

    "Okay, stop talking."

    Several junior sisters looked at her.

    "What's wrong with Senior Sister Churan?"

    "I want to go back to Chen Mo and borrow his high-grade spells to practice."

    Several junior sisters were stunned when they heard this.

    "Senior Sister Churan, are you kidding me? If you ask him to borrow a high-grade spell, will he lend it to you?"

    "That's right. Now he even dares to hit Senior Brother Lu Yun. Do you think he will treat you like he did before?"

    Several junior sisters looked at each other without speaking.

    At this moment, they were thinking that Senior Sister Chu Ran was too naive. Chen Mo was different now.

    In the past, he was a loser who was looked down upon by everyone, so of course he had to please Senior Sister Churan in every possible way. Now that he has defeated even Lu Yun, can he still look after Senior Sister Churan?

    But they couldn't throw cold water on her face so they had to follow her back.

    When Chen Mo was about to go back to the house, there were footsteps again outside the courtyard door.

    Jiang Churan saw the junior sisters behind him, so he frowned slightly.

    "Anything else?"

    When Jiang Churan walked into the yard and stood in front of him, he hesitated and spoke.

    "Chen Mo, I want to discuss something with you."

    "What's the matter?"

    "Can you lend me your high-grade spell to practice?"

    After she finished speaking, she looked at Chen Mo with a bit of expectation in her eyes.

    "Just borrow it for a few days and return it to you as soon as I finish practicing."

    However, Chen Mo looked at her and said nothing.

    Then I thought to myself.

    Borrow a high-quality spell? This woman is quite good at making wishful thinking.

    In the memory of the original owner, this woman often took things from the original owner.

    She wanted spiritual stones, pills, spells, and whatever the original owner had. In order to please her, the original owner gave her all his cultivation resources, but as a result, his cultivation was wasted.

    And what about her?

    After taking the things, he ignored him.

    Occasionally, the original owner would give me a smile and say a few nice words, but then he would continue to give away things.

    Isn’t this pure green tea?
title_en: Chapter 13 Do you dare to hit a woman?
